about_paragraph: Discover Sho Coffee & Bar, a hidden gem in downtown Winnipeg offering an incredible atmosphere perfect for both morning coffee and evening drinks. Enjoy a smooth cold brew and top-tier service from a welcoming staff who make you feel valued. With a relaxed ambiance, you'll always find a seat and never feel rushed.
